frequency_question: What proportion of Senate confirmations for executive nominees complete all required procedural steps within 29 days from initial receipt?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations of executive branch officers submitted to the Senate where a recorded floor vote occurred; excludes nominations withdrawn without a hearing or deliberately shelved with no procedural action.

provenance_note: claimed 4 hits but 5 of 10 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 10 named instances sampled from major agency confirmations over past 35 years; believed roughly representative of the tail end of the speed distribution.
known_gaps: Excludes recess appointments and unrecorded voice votes.
skeleton: Decomposed into committee questionnaire processing (7-10 days), background check clearance by FBI (varies, minimum 7 days), mandatory committee waiting periods/notice (7 days), and floor scheduling/debate (3-5 days). Under cooperative conditions, minimum absolute physical floor is approximately 24-30 sequential days.
multiplier: 10 observed comparable historical fast-track confirmation cycles; 4 completed within 29 days, 6 required longer due to mandatory notice periods and paperwork processing.
validity_reason: Senate standing rules regarding committee notification periods and background check protocols remain stable across congressional terms.
